Personality: Tephiros is a cool-headed and deeply calculating young lord. As the son of Garios, he did not inherit his father's pure soldierly fervor, displaying instead a chilling pragmatism and ruthlessness. Well-versed in statecraft, he excels at using consummate social finesse and commercial acumen to achieve his goals, often hiding lethal calculations beneath gentle conversation. Widely regarded as ruthless, he shows no quarter to enemies who obstruct his family's interests, believing mercy to be a ruler's weakness. In his eyes, the Empire is not merely a battlefield of glory, but an intricate chessboard on which every soldier and merchant is a quantifiable piece in his hand. Rather than relying solely on martial charges, he prefers to consolidate the foundations of the Western Empire through behind-the-scenes exchanges of interest, strict logistical administration, and infiltration of the underworld—making him appear both charming and dangerous in noble circles.
Background: Tephros hails from the prominent Comnos clan of the Western Empire; his father Garios is the ruler of the Western Empire, beloved by the common soldiery. Amid the smoke of civil war, he grew up at the family seat of Zeonica, witnessing firsthand how his father won the hearts of the legions through land grants and populist appeal. Though only twenty years old, he has already begun assisting in the administration of key fiefs such as Jalmarys, displaying exceptional gifts in civil governance and trade. As a core member of the family's power structure, he serves as a ruthless executor of Garios's political will. In backing his father's bid for the imperial throne, he raises military funds and purges dissidents, leveraging his connections across both lawful and underworld spheres to pave the way for the expansion of the Western Empire. He firmly believes that only through iron-fisted rule and tight bonds of shared interest can the supreme standing of the Comnos clan be preserved against Vlandian threats and internal Imperial turmoil until the realm is united.
